title: Mightve found a new building type or I mightve found out mall world is part of a bigger structure?
content: I was in this massive tower that I belive was rectangular in shape, but the outline of a rectangle, so there was an interior portion of open air. And theres structure in between the 2 sides of the tower so you can walk into the middle of it, but if you look off the edge of the platform the tower goes down indefinitely and you just see a white fog/mist, no bottom. There seemed to be advanced beings where i was at in the tower and they had an interest in gold (golden accents in the architecture, they had golden like helmets or headpieces on i belive? And they could talk telepathically There was this massive empty tank, semicircle shaped coming out of the wall and a bridge that connected the tank to the other side of the building. These black and white slightly amorphious balls appeared suddenly in the tank and as they did water appeared with them and they would suddenly jump in size and as they did they took the shape of chunky orcas, then they and the water would vanish and the process would start again I head a voice in my head tell me that this is how they fed everyone in this place. Then its like my mind was flooded with the knowledge that every "floor?" In this building was a different place entirely. On the other side of the bridge across from the tank, the architecture seemed a little more Egyptian? And there was a strip that ran on the inside of the buildings wall (still open air) and the floor was like this packed sand dirt mixture. And there were 2 guardians there, one was a biomechancial humanoid and the other was a centaur that was about 12 feet tall and it also had one of those golden headpieces. They were guarding this door that I went through but thats where it gets weird. Its like my memory got jumbled up. I remeber walking into a low ceiling dark room with that same packed sand dirt mixture and pillars in a grid pattern. But I also have the feeling that the room was grand, like a egyptian x church hybrid with a throne where the altar would be but thats all I remeber. But on top of that I remeber walking through the doors into this house like structure with fancy wooden interior and maybe middle school aged kids were running around like they lived there. (It was like I had several memories stacked on top of each other) I remeber walking down some stairs in the wooden architecture area and turning right into this elevator room that matched the materials and designs from the outside area where the orca tank is and the elevator was this circular platform/disk that decended to these doors that opened and I remeber a bright light when the doors opened but then my memory goes blank. Which leads into the second part of the dream I remeber walking through the hospital hallway but there also a blackness in my memory from what happened before I was walking through the hallway (distinct from the blackness after the elevator doors opened so somthing happened after that and before I was in the hospital hallway that i cant remember) But walking through the hospital hallway i noticed the reception desk was facing twords the inside of the hospital, like you wouldn't be able to see it walking into the hospital. Which i thought was odd. Then the hallway just let out onto the second floor of the mall So im wondering that since MW is its own persistant place that what if its connected to a larger persistant structure? Only saying this because I was told each floor of this tower is different, I decend on an elevator, memory goes black, then i end up walking out from the hospital into the mall. So did I decend into MW from a differnt dream? is the tower simply a structure thats part of MW or is MW a part of it? maybe im reaching, Idk let me know what you think and if you've ever experience somthing like this, including the weird memory stuff. Note: also after having this dream I remembered that I had already been to mw, I didnt think I had, I just didnt remeber. Several dreams came back to me that I never wrote down. one in the bottom floor of the mall, one in the parking garage, one on top on a massive hill/ small mountain with apartments on top of it that butted up to some woods, the hill was just on the outskirts of a city. one with a bakery/deli in a city where the basement was like a older style office building decor but it was extreanly small with an elevator, And one with a large hexagonal? Locker room and a large bathroom connected to it. So im assuming those all took place in MW
